title: Level 1 - Crypto Wasteland World Blueprint v3

coordinateSystem.runtimeConversion: subtract authored spawn (8,78), making the live player spawn world (0,0)

designIntent: A compact handcrafted adventure map with a readable critical spine, two optional loops, natural downhill hydrology, strong landmarks, broad swarm arenas, short cat-and-mouse chokepoints, and diegetic borders.

adventureLoops.title: Pine Shadow and Mesa Loop
adventureLoops.risk: tight forest ambushes and ridge ranged pressure

adventureLoops.title: Hashrate, Farm, and Coast Loop
adventureLoops.risk: open swarm fields, outlet chokepoint, and coastal mini-boss

routePresentation.authority: visual-only; collision and traversal remain authored layer contracts
routePresentation.centerlineModel: expanded authored control points with merged eight-direction junctions

pointsOfInterest.title: Dry Forest Cave
pointsOfInterest.landmark: dark cave mouth beneath old pine wall

pointsOfInterest.title: Mesa Overlook
pointsOfInterest.landmark: switchback ridge and Litecoin City sightline

pointsOfInterest.title: Old Hashrate Camp
pointsOfInterest.landmark: half-buried mining rigs and dragon bones

pointsOfInterest.title: Silver Wallet Lakeside
pointsOfInterest.landmark: reeds, ruined wallet shrine, shallow ford

pointsOfInterest.title: Rugpull Gulch Boss Yard
pointsOfInterest.landmark: ruined vault facade and backlit scam billboard

hydrology.model: two mountain tributaries feed Silver Wallet Lake; one outlet descends through farms and coast into the southern sea

structurePolicy.trees: trunk footprint blocks; canopy is overhang/occlusion only
structurePolicy.buildings: multi-cell footprint plus door and route sockets
structurePolicy.mountains: blocked plateau/cliff polygons plus explicit slope openings

actorPolicies.player: swept-circle collision against blocked terrain, edge barriers, and solid footprints
actorPolicies.groundEnemy: grid/flow-field navigation plus local footprint avoidance and swept collision
actorPolicies.airEnemy: ignores ground/water/prop footprints but respects world perimeter and explicit air blockers

beats: 0:00-0:35 spawn orientation and first road choice
2:35-3:45 crossroads rest, draft, and optional mini-boss resolution
pacing.activationRule: All arenas exist physically; one optional mini-boss route is promoted per run while other arenas host elites, events, or rewards.

route.encoding: . none, M main spine, N north loop, S south loop, T town street, B bridge

artGrammar.adjacency: Each tile-context row records north/east/south/west terrain; runtime art selects edge and corner variants from a Wang-style mask.
artGrammar.sourceCanvas: square transparent source containing a centered 2:1 isometric diamond; normalize to 64x32 logical footprint
artGrammar.pixelStyle: high-detail 16-bit arcade pixel art, controlled palette, crisp clusters, no painterly blur, no text, consistent northwest key light

seamContract.buildingPolicy: Buildings are multi-cell structure/overhang chunks with explicit footprints and bottom-center anchors; never crop them into unrelated ground tiles.
seamContract.mountainPolicy: Mountain ground, cliff faces, caps, and overhangs are separate connected layers; cliff connectors declare continuation across chunk boundaries.
seamContract.generationPolicy: Generate connected supertile concepts and material masters; deterministic masks own final topology and seams.

approvalGate.stopCondition: User approves map plan, palette, pixel density, projection, lighting, and edge-connectivity quality.
